memorii.titlu: [GMAIL] Stop bad code before it merges
memorii.detalii:
De la: The CodeRabbit Team <hello@coderabbit.ai>
ID Gmail: 1a213a0e3c86c02e
Thread: 1a213a0e3c86c02e
Data: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:54:00 +0000
Subiect: Stop bad code before it merges

Conținut:
CodeRabbit

 

Hi bogdanstancu1119-maker,

Two features that work together. Set them up once and CodeRabbit enforces your team's conventions on every PR.

1. Path instructions → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/configuration/path-instructions )

Teach CodeRabbit your codebase rules per directory.

reviews:
  path_instructions:
    - path: "src/api/**"
      instructions: |
        - All endpoints must validate input via zod schemas
        - Auth middleware required before route handlers

2. Pre-merge checks → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/pr-reviews/pre-merge-checks )

Block PRs that violate your standards.

reviews:
  pre_merge_checks:
    docstrings:
      mode: "warning"
      threshold: 80
    description:
      mode: "warning"

Start both in warning mode. Move to error once your team is aligned. When paired with the Request Changes Workflow ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/reference/configuration#param-request-changes-workflow ), error mode blocks merges until issues are resolved or manually overridden.

Learn more about path instructions → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/configuration/path-instructions )

Learn more about pre-merge checks → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/pr-reviews/pre-merge-checks )

App Integrations

memorii.detalii:

Thread: 1a213a0e3c86c02e
Data: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:54:00 +0000
Subiect: Stop bad code before it merges

Conținut:
CodeRabbit

 

Hi bogdanstancu1119-maker,

Two features that work together. Set them up once and CodeRabbit enforces your team's conventions on every PR.

1. Path instructions → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/configuration/path-instructions )

Teach CodeRabbit your codebase rules per directory.

reviews:
  path_instructions:
    - path: "src/api/**"
      instructions: |
        - All endpoints must validate input via zod schemas
        - Auth middleware required before route handlers

2. Pre-merge checks → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/pr-reviews/pre-merge-checks )

Block PRs that violate your standards.

reviews:
  pre_merge_checks:
    docstrings:
      mode: "warning"
      threshold: 80
    description:
      mode: "warning"

Start both in warning mode. Move to error once your team is aligned. When paired with the Request Changes Workflow ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/reference/configuration#param-request-changes-workflow ), error mode blocks merges until issues are resolved or manually overridden.

Learn more about path instructions → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/configuration/path-instructions )

Learn more about pre-merge checks → ( https://docs.coderabbit.ai/pr-reviews/pre-merge-checks )

App Integrations
